description: Resolver input for the optional Qwen3-TTS runtime. Consumed by scripts/lock_qwen_runtime.py (Task 2.2) to render per-platform, checksum-pinned runtime manifests. Nothing here is a base-app dependency: qwen-tts, PyTorch and Transformers stay out of pyproject.toml and uv.lock.

dependencyPolicy.rationale: qwen-tts 0.1.1 declares transformers==4.57.3, accelerate==1.12.0, gradio, librosa, torchaudio, soundfile, sox, onnxruntime and einops in requires_dist. Installing a hand-picked subset risks import-time failures inside the isolated runtime, so the lock script resolves the declared closure and pins every wheel by URL, size and SHA-256.
knownRisks: The 'sox' distribution wraps the system sox binary; the model host must not require it at import or inference time. Verified during Task 3.2 real-runtime validation; if a code path needs it, the runtime manifest must ship the binary per platform.
onnxruntime is pulled by qwen-tts metadata although the 0.6B checkpoints are safetensors/PyTorch; it stays pinned as part of the closure.
qwen-tts pins transformers==4.57.3 while the base app pins 4.57.6; process isolation (model host subprocess) is the only supported resolution.
